content: Meeteŋana ki Lasarus
Tomtom ta ki kar Betania, zaana Lasarus. Ni mete ikami. Ni ziŋan lunuri bizin ru, Mata mi Maria, timbotmbot. Maria tana, ta kaimer iliŋ ŋgere kuziiniŋana ise Yesu kumbuunu, mi imus pa ute ruunu na.
Tana Lasarus mete ikami, to moori ru tana tikam sua ma ila pa Yesu ma tiso: “Biibi, toyam Lasarus ta nu lelem pini ilip, ta mete biibi ikami ma isaana kat.”
Yesu ileŋ sua tana, to iso: “Mete tana ipet be ikam ma Lasarus imeete pa i na som. Inako iwe zaala pa Anutu be iswe mburaana. Naso ziru Lutuunu zan iwe biibi.”
Yesu, ni leleene ilip pa Mata ziru tiziini moori Maria mi ton Lasarus.
Mi ileŋ kembei Lasarus mete biibi ikami na, loŋa mi ila ire i som. Imbotmbot lele tana pa ka mbeŋ ru tomen,
mana iso pizin naŋgaŋ kini ma iso: “Ouo, iti timiili ma tala mini pa lele pakaana ki Yudea.”
Mi naŋgaŋ kini tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Mos katuunu, buri ŋonoono ta wal tana tisombe tipunu pa pat. Mi iŋgi sombe miili ma la mini?”

Ni ipekel kwon ma iso: “Waa, zugut ka nol ipet zen. Iŋgi aigule biibi ta Anutu iur piti be takam uraata. Tana zin ko tirao be tikam kosa sa piti loŋa na som. Tomtom ta sombe ipa pa aigule, inako itutkati som. Pa mat ki toono, ta iyaara pini.
Mi sombe ni ipa pa mbeŋ, inako itutkati. Paso, mat iyaara pini som.”
To Yesu iseeŋge sua kini ma iso: “Torondo Lasarus, ni ikenne a. Mi nio ko aŋla be aŋpai i ma imaŋga mini.”
Tabe naŋgaŋ kini tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Biibi, sombe ni ikenne lene a, nako niini ambaimbai kek.”
Yesu, ni iute Lasarus imeete kek. Tamen ni ipambaara ka sua, tabe naŋgaŋ kini tikam kat ŋgar som, mi tisombe Lasarus ikenne men.

Tana Yesu iso kat pizin ma iso: “Lasarus, ni imeete ma kup kek. Pa nio loŋa mi aŋla aŋurpe i som. Mi iŋgi ambai bekena tala ma kere, to iuulu yom ma kuurla. Tana nio leleŋ ambai. Ayo, kamaŋga mi tala tere i.”
Tabe Tomas, ta tipaata zaana toro be Didimus na, iso pa waene bizin ma iso: “Toŋgo, tala. Sombe tipun biibi kiti, na tipun iti tomini. Naso itiŋan mi temetmeete raraate.”
Yesu, ni maŋgaŋana mi mbotŋana mata yaryaaraŋana katuunu
Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini timaŋga ma tila, mi tigarau kar Betania na, ileŋ kembei Lasarus, ni imeete ma titwi i, mi imbot pa ka mbeŋ paŋ kek.
Kar Betania tana, ina imbot kolouŋana pa kar biibi Yerusalem. Irao kembei kilomita tel ma iŋgi.
Tana Yuda boozo, ta timar ma ziŋan Mata ma Maria timbotmbot be tipalumluumu lelen pa ton Lasarus ta imeete na.
Indeeŋe Mata ileŋ Yesu uruunu kembei iwwa ma imar na, iyooto ma ila be ire i. Mi Maria, ni imbotmbot men ruumu.
Mata ila ipet ki Yesu, to iso pini ma iso: “O Merere, kozobe nu mbot taiŋgi, so atoŋ imeete som.
Mi tamen nio aŋute: Nu sombe suŋ Anutu pa koroŋ sa, nako ileŋ la kalŋom.”
To Yesu iso pini: “Tom ko burup ma imaŋga mini.”
Mi Mata ipekel kwoono ma iso: “E. Nio aŋute. Mbeŋ kaimer iso ipet mi Anutu ipei zin meeteŋan ma timaŋga mini, to ni ko burup ma imaŋga mini.”
Tona Yesu iso pini: “Leŋ. Nio ituŋ ta maŋgaŋana mi mbotŋana mata yaryaaraŋana katuunu. Tomtom ta sombe iurla tio mi imeete, na meeteŋana ko irao ikisi na som. Kola imaŋga mini.
Mi tomtom ta sombe ikam mbotŋana ta ki Anutu i mi iurla tio, inako irao imeete ma ila ne na som. Parei, nu urla sua taiŋgi, som som?”
Mata ipekel kwoono ma iso: “E, Merere nio aŋurla kat ta kembei: Nu Mesia. Anutu Lutuunu tamen ta nu na. Ni iŋgo u ta su toono ti, kembei ta sua iso pataaŋa kek.”
Yesu itaŋ pa Lasarus
Mata ziru Yesu tizzo sua tana makiŋ, to Mata imiili ma ila pa ruumu, mi imburum lae pa tiziini moori ma iso: “Mos katuunu ta imar kek ma imbotmbot a. Mi iso ire u.”
Maria ileŋ sua tana na, loŋa men mi iyooto ma ila ire Yesu.
Indeeŋe tana, Yesu ber pet kar zen. Imbotmbot men lele ta muŋgu Mata ila ipet kini pa na.
Zin wal ta ziŋan Maria timbotmbot mi tipalumluumu leleene na, tire Maria burup ma imaŋga mi izem ruumu ma ila, to tito i ma ziŋan tila. Pa tiso ko ila pa naala ki Lasarus be itaŋ pini.
Maria ila ipet ki Yesu, to itop su kereene uunu mi iso: “O Merere, kozobe nu mbot, so atoŋ imeete som.”
Yesu ire ni ziŋan zin iwal biibi tana titaŋ, to leleene isaana, mi keteene malmal tomini.
To iwi zin ma iso: “Lasarus, kitwi i sula swoi?” Mi zin tiso pini: “Merere, mar tala to re.”
To Yesu mata luluunu isu.
Mi iwal biibi tiso: “Kere. Ni leleene pa Lasarus ilip.”
Mi tomtom kizin pakan tiparso pizin ma tiso: “Mi ni ta iurpe tomtom mata pisŋana tau. Kozobe ni imbotmbot, so tomtom ti imeete som.”
Yesu ipei Lasarus ma imaŋga mini
Yesu ire mbulu ma keteene malmal pa meeteŋana mini. Tabe ipaŋuru naala ki Lasarus ma ila. Naala tana, tikel lela raŋ, mi tipakaala kwoono pa pat biibi.

Ni ila ma ipet naala uunu to iso: “Kuzuuru pat tana ma ilae.” To Mata, ta tomtom meeteŋana tana lunuri na, iso pa Yesu. Iso: “E-e Merere, kembena pepe. Pa niam amtwi i ma ka mbeŋ paŋ kek. Ko kuziini ma iŋgi.”
Mi Yesu iso pini: “Mata, nio aŋso pu na, nu leŋ som? Nu sombe urla, nako re Anutu iswe kat mburaana ta buri.”
To tizuuru pat ma ilae pa naala kwoono, mi Yesu mataana isala kor, mi iso: “O Tamaŋ, nio leleŋ ambai pu mi aŋpakuru. Pa suŋŋana tio, nu leŋ kek.
Nio aŋute: Nu leŋleŋ kalŋoŋ totomen. Mi aŋso sua ti bekena zin wal taiŋgi tiurla kembei: Nu ta ŋgo yo ma aŋmar i.”
Ni iso sua tana makiŋ, to kalŋaana biibi ma iso: “Lasarus, yooto ma pet!”
To Lasarus imaŋga ma ipet, ramaki mburu ta tizuki pa mi tiuri lela naala leleene na. Ipet to, Yesu iso pizin: “Kepeeze mburu ta imbot la namaana, kumbuunu, mi mataana na. Naso ipa kat ma ila.”
Zin bibip timbuuru pa Yesu
Zin Yuda ta timar ki Maria na, tire uraata tana, to tomtom kizin boozo tiurla ki Yesu.
Tamen tomtom kizin pakan tila kizin tutu kan, mi tiŋgal talŋan pa uraata tana.
Tabe zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan mi zin tutu kan tila ma ziŋan zin peeze kan kizin Yuda tilup zin mi tiso: “To tana, iŋgi kozo ko takam parei pini? Pa ni itortooro koroŋ boozo mete.

Sombe tepeteke i som, mi inoknok men ta kembei, inako tomtom ta boozomen tiurla kini mi tito i. Tona zin Rom ko timar mi tireege Urum Merere kiti, mi tiyaŋgwiiri iti ma itundu tarao be tomboro lele kiti mini som.”
Timbotmbot mi tomtom kizin ta, zaana Kaipas, ni iwe mataana pizin patoronŋana kan pa ndaama tana. Imaŋga mi iso pizin ma iso: “Niom leyom ŋgar sa som!
Kakam parei, ta katalli ta kembena. Kere. Ni tomtom tamen ŋonoono. Sombe ikam murindi mi imeete piti, inako ambai piti. Kokena imbot, to itiŋan zin iwal biibi tamap ma tala lende.”

Ndaama tana, Kaipas iwe mataana pizin patoronŋana kan. Tana sua ta ni iso pa Yesu ko ikam zin Yuda murin mi imeete pizin na, iso sorok pa itunu ŋgar kini som. Ina, Anutu ikam peeze pini ma iso sua tana. Tana kaimer indeeŋe Yesu imeete na, sua kini tana iur ŋonoono.
Mi Yesu imeete pizin Yuda men som. Ni imeete pa Anutu lutuunu bizin boozomen ta timbot leŋaleŋa na, bekena ilup zin ma tiwe lupŋana tamen.
Indeeŋe aigule tina mi ila na, zin bibip kizin Yuda timbuuru Yesu kana be tipuni ma imeete.
Tana ni ipa se matan mini som. Izem zin, mi ila pa kar Eparaim ta imbot lele bilimŋana zilŋaana na, mi ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini timbotmbot tana.

Timbotmbot to lupŋana biibi kizin Yuda, ta tipaata be Pasoba na, ka nol igarau. Tana iwal karkari tizalla pa Yerusalem be tiurpe zitun ma tiŋgeeze pa Anutu mataana kembei ta tutu kizin iso na, mana Pasoba ipet.
Mi timbotmbot Urum Merere kwoono mi tikir Yesu mataana, to tiparso pizin ta kembei: “Oo, niom kakam ŋgar be parei? Lupŋana biibi ti, ni ko imar pa?”
Mi zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan mi zin tutu kan tiur sua pizin iwal biibi kek. Beso tire Yesu imbot lele sa, na loŋa mi sua ikam zin, bekena tikisi.

footnotes.text: Yesu keteene malmal pizin tomtom som. Ni keteene malmal pa sanaana mi meeteŋana, mi pataŋana ta meeteŋana ikamam pizin tomtom.
